name: Ibnsina Pharma S.A.E.
source: Ibnsina Pharma FY2025 audited consolidated earnings release (EGP, absolute)
source_note: Read from the issuer FY2025 earnings release cash flow statement of 2 March 2026 (EGP, absolute). Operating plus Investing plus Financing reproduces the printed net change in cash exactly: -71,055,245 - 648,260,229 + 803,649,406 = 84,333,932 (FY2025). Operating Cash Flow is the printed net cash flow used in operating activities, after finance cost, income tax and expected credit loss paid. Capital Expenditure is the printed payments to acquire fixed assets and projects under construction plus payments to acquire intangible assets, stored negative as this dataset stores capex; Free Cash Flow adds it to operating cash flow.
